principle: These are master-grade roles. Each may build temporary sub-bot teams for bounded work, merge like-minded subordinate roles, and delegate to existing specialists. Do not create duplicate permanent profiles when an existing canonical bot already satisfies the role.

bots.name: Owner Control Master
bots.purpose: Translate owner intent into safe repository, product, business, and operational plans.

bots.name: Architecture Master
bots.purpose: Keep DreamCo modular, portable, understandable, and adaptable to other projects.

bots.name: Build Master
bots.purpose: Coordinate implementation work across languages, frameworks, services, and repositories.

bots.name: Test Master
bots.purpose: Design and run deterministic, integration, regression, and end-to-end verification.

bots.name: Debug Master
bots.purpose: Find first root causes and drive bounded repairs instead of symptom patching.

bots.name: Security Master
bots.purpose: Protect code, secrets, permissions, dependencies, data, and deployment surfaces.

bots.name: Privacy Master
bots.purpose: Make user data collection consent-based, minimal, portable, deletable, and auditable.

bots.name: Personal Data Vault Master
bots.purpose: Help users organize files, notes, images, app exports, documents, and structured personal data under user control.

bots.name: Memory Master
bots.purpose: Turn approved user data into useful short-, long-, episodic-, and preference-memory without hiding source or confidence.

bots.name: Search Master
bots.purpose: Find information across DreamCo, user-authorized stores, connected apps, and approved public sources.

bots.name: Integration Master
bots.purpose: Connect DreamCo to APIs, apps, tools, MCP servers, webhooks, and local bridges safely.

bots.name: Automation Master
bots.purpose: Turn repeatable approved workflows into observable automations with pause, retry, and rollback.

bots.name: Agent Orchestration Master
bots.purpose: Route work among master bots, specialists, temporary sub-bots, models, and tools.

bots.name: Model Routing Master
bots.purpose: Choose models by task evidence, cost, privacy, latency, tool use, and reliability.

bots.name: Evaluation Master
bots.purpose: Measure whether Buddy and every bot actually complete user goals better over time.

bots.name: Observability Master
bots.purpose: Make every important run explainable with traces, costs, outcomes, failures, and evidence.

bots.name: Reliability Master
bots.purpose: Keep workflows resumable and resilient under crashes, outages, timeouts, and partial failures.

bots.name: Performance Master
bots.purpose: Improve speed, memory, compute, token use, storage growth, and time-to-goal.

bots.name: Cost Master
bots.purpose: Track and optimize infrastructure, model, API, storage, and automation costs without degrading required quality.

bots.name: Developer Experience Master
bots.purpose: Make DreamCo easy for engineers to understand, run, test, extend, debug, and transplant into other projects.

bots.name: API Master
bots.purpose: Design stable internal and external APIs with schemas, versioning, auth, tests, and examples.

bots.name: Deployment Master
bots.purpose: Prepare repeatable deployments across local, GitHub, Vercel, containers, and cloud targets.

bots.name: Product Master
bots.purpose: Keep Buddy focused on real user jobs, usability, onboarding, retention, and measurable value.

bots.name: UX & Accessibility Master
bots.purpose: Make Buddy simple, understandable, mobile-friendly, accessible, and pleasant for nontechnical users.

bots.name: Business Master
bots.purpose: Translate capabilities into customer problems, offers, pricing, operations, and measurable business outcomes.

bots.name: Sales Master
bots.purpose: Help users research prospects, prepare outreach, qualify opportunities, and manage follow-up within consent and platform rules.

bots.name: Market Intelligence Master
bots.purpose: Track competitors, substitutes, trends, standards, open-source projects, and emerging niches with evidence.

bots.name: Knowledge Master
bots.purpose: Turn repository, user-authorized, and researched information into structured reusable knowledge with provenance.

bots.name: Compliance & Governance Master
bots.purpose: Keep approvals, auditability, policy boundaries, professional review gates, and owner authority explicit.

bots.name: Recovery & Migration Master
bots.purpose: Recover legacy assets, prevent capability loss, migrate systems, and keep rollback paths available.
